description: Valerie asked to see the site live: deploy lofsite (with the gallery, charts and sandbox) to her server, reachable as core@waler (uCore/Fedora CoreOS, podman, Tailscale). Package the app as a container, bake the pilot-v0 artifacts in (parquets are small; the 600MB logs stay local), install a quadlet unit, and report the URL. Must not disturb existing services on the box. Deployment config files are committed to the repo so redeploys are repeatable; the bench-release skill's site-refresh step should reference them.
title: Deploy lofsite to waler as a podman quadlet service
